description: 183 LEDs WITH 120° WIDE BEAM ANGLE — Provides bright white illumination across a wide coverage area, suitable for driveways, compounds, gates, and garden walls. For best brightness performance, mount at the recommended height and angle with a clear, unobstructed line to open sky for the solar panel. 4000mAh RECHARGEABLE BATTERY, 10-12 HOUR RUNTIME — The built-in 3.7V lithium-ion battery provides an average of 10-12 hours of continuous illumination on a full charge. Runtime can vary based on seasonal sunlight availability and panel placement — for best results in monsoon or low-sunlight periods, ensure the panel gets maximum direct exposure during the day. 6W/6V SOLAR PANEL WITH UP TO 17% CONVERSION EFFICIENCY — Converts sunlight into stored energy efficiently, working alongside the automatic on/off dusk-to-dawn feature so you never need to manually switch the light on or off. IP65 WATERPROOF, DURABLE METAL & GLASS CONSTRUCTION — Built to handle rain and harsh weather conditions. (Please inspect your unit carefully upon delivery — if the housing arrives cracked or damaged in any way, please contact us immediately for a replacement before installation, as waterproofing depends on an intact housing.) IR REMOTE WITH MULTIPLE LIGHTING MODES & ADJUSTABLE INSTALLATION — Control the light from 20-30 ft away with the included remote, choosing from multiple lighting modes and a 2-6 hour energy-saving timer setting. The adjustable wall mount bracket allows installation on walls, garage entrances, or as ground-based patio/security lighting.
